tools.name: dealmachine_mail_settings_update
tools.description: Saves the workspace default single-postcard schedule shared by web and mobile. This changes a preference and sends no mail. Repeat forever requires a positive supported interval. Send all three values together when changing the schedule.

tools.name: dealmachine_mail_campaign_send
tools.description: Launches a draft mail campaign and spends wallet dollars for its recipients and scheduled steps.

tools.name: dealmachine_mail_campaign_add_properties
tools.description: Adds properties to a Ready, Active or Paused campaign and spends wallet dollars. Each added property starts at step 1 on its own schedule; properties already in the campaign are untouched. Before calling this, call dealmachine_mail_read with operation add_properties_estimate and the property count,

tools.name: dealmachine_mail_campaign_archive
tools.description: Archives an ended campaign. End active, paused, ready or draft campaigns first; otherwise the API returns 409 CAMPAIGN_NOT_ENDED without changing the campaign. tools.name: dealmachine_mail_campaign_end
tools.description: Ends a Ready, Active or Paused mail campaign permanently. Unsent mail is stopped, no properties can be added, and it can never be resumed. Mail already printed or with the carrier still delivers. To reuse its steps, create a new campaign. A draft has not started and cannot be ended (campaign_is_draf

tools.name: dealmachine_mail_campaign_cancel
tools.description: Cancels a mail campaign, kept for existing clients. A started campaign ends as with dealmachine_mail_campaign_end; a draft is cancelled; a campaign that has already ended is returned unchanged. Unsent mail stops, while mail already submitted still delivers.

tools.name: dealmachine_webhook_list
tools.description: Lists the workspace’s outbound webhooks with their event types and delivery health, plus the catalog of event types when asked. Free.

tools.name: dealmachine_webhook_create
tools.description: Registers an https URL to receive prospect and list events. Returns the signing secret once; relay it to the user. Free.
